additional_info.subject: ID0393915-DC/Si-D/CH[170002200] - DC4 is not working CRM:00315002156
additional_info.body:
Dear José,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Manor Genf
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
xgesXO
Problem Description
: DC4 is not working due to communication error and possibly temperature sensor
Troubleshooting
:
There are 2 error flags at the moment:
For the first error we should look for the ethernet connection and see if everything is alright, you can swap the ethernet cable with the DC3 and see if it works again and the CableTempSensor error is also gone.
If the CableTempSensor is not working, please check these connections:
You should measure resistance and it should be close to 1kOhm.
If this resistance is correct then move on to the KF214 and see if this value reaches the input of the KF214.
If we have 1kOhm at the input (before the connector) and we still face this error, you can try changing the small connector for one neighbour that is not in use:
If this still doesn't work then we need to think about replacing KF214.
If the resistance you measure in XD212:7B or 8D is very different than 1kOhm then the cable can be faulty and needs to be replaced.
Let me know if you need assistance on site, I would recommend first to only bring a spare KF212, KF214 and Ethernet cable.
Have you tried rebooting the charger and see if it comes back?
For future reference, your ticket number is
0393915
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim

additional_info.subject: ID0393915-DC/Si-D/CH[170002200] - DC4 is not working CRM:00315002156
additional_info.body:
Hi José,
Thanks for the feedback.
I will refer as B to the charger ID: xgesXO and A as VqE7xu.
What was the analysis that the EcoG was faulty? What measurements did you make? Did you connect your laptop to the switch and check if the IP address was there? Did you connect directly to the EcoG and see if the WebUI was there and showed any errors?
Did you change the Ethernet cable as I requested? Did you check the CableTempSensor resistance? Did you replace the EcoG connector?
What I understand from your email is that you swapped the EcoGs between chargers and hoped it would work, and since it didn't you tried a new one. If there is a new EcoG it's close to impossible that it doesn't work.
I also asked that if you needed assistance to reach out to me. If I couldn't support you, I can always find someone to give you assistance. You know you can always count me for better or worse, I think Marco knows this ;)
Let me know if you are planning a new site visit, as this problem cannot be solved remotely because I still don't have access to the EcoGs. As long as I have this error flag “
SECC_DC4_MB_Problem_KF212
” there is nothing I can do.
I have merged the both tickets just in this one so that it's easier for both of us.
Thank you very much!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0393915-DC/Si-D/CH[170002200] - DC4 is not working CRM:00315002156
additional_info.body:
Hi José,
After today's visit, we troubleshooted the issues with the EcoG's. Here is a short summary and theory on why it didn't work for B:
When you swapped the faulty EcoG with the other one, it worked until you made the reboot. This makes me believe that the EcoG was doing an update in something related to the FW and when you rebooted it got corrupted and that's why it's not working anymore. We are able to ping it and there are values but the Modbus communication is still inexistent.
For the new EcoG, it seems that the version that you applied from Companion was not the right one and caused some troubles too, when we updated it to the latest version it still didn't work properly.
We also found that there is an error on StateMonitor that is related to the temparture sensor but we measured all the sensors and they all showed 1kOhm until the input of the KF214.
For this charger we need to order 1 new EcoG LE and 1 StateMonitor:
KF212 - 8EM5903-0AA00-5AA6
KF214 - 8EM5903-0AA03-2AA6
Please make sure that you have the newest Companion tool and use the DC4 to comission the EcoG.
For the A charger, we were not able to test since there were 3 persons charging in this charger, we can also access the EcoG via SSH and everything so it isn't a problem with the Ethernet cable.
Please bring a spare EcoG to this one since it is the one that the update might've been corrupted.
I will send this ticket for the RC-CH queue since I will be going on vacation. Please proceed with the replacement.
Thank you very much and have a nice weekend!
best regards,
Francisco

After today's visit, we troubleshooted the issues with the EcoG's. Here is a short summary and theory on why it didn't work for B:
When you swapped the faulty EcoG with the other one, it worked until you made the reboot. This makes me believe that the EcoG was doing an update
in something related to the FW and when you rebooted it got corrupted and that's why it's not working anymore. We are able to ping it and there are values but the Modbus communication is still inexistent.
For the new EcoG, it seems that the version that you applied from Companion was not the right one and caused some troubles too, when we updated it
to the latest version it still didn't work properly.
We also found that there is an error on StateMonitor that is related to the temparture sensor but we measured all the sensors and they all showed
1kOhm until the input of the KF214.
For this charger we need to order 1 new EcoG LE and 1 StateMonitor:
KF212 - 8EM5903-0AA00-5AA6
KF214 - 8EM5903-0AA03-2AA6
Please make sure that you have the newest Companion tool and use the DC4 to comission the EcoG.
For the A charger, we were not able to test since there were 3 persons charging in this charger, we can also access the EcoG via SSH and everything
so it isn't a problem with the Ethernet cable.
Please bring a spare EcoG to this one since it is the one that the update might've been corrupted.
I will send this ticket for the RC-CH queue since I will be going on vacation. Please proceed with the replacement.
Thank you very much and have a nice weekend!
best regards,

temperature sensor
Troubleshooting
:
There are 2 error flags at the moment:
For the first error we should look for the ethernet connection and see if everything is alright, you can swap the ethernet cable with the DC3 and
see if it works again and the CableTempSensor error is also gone.
If the CableTempSensor is not working, please check these connections:
You should measure resistance and it should be close to 1kOhm.
If this resistance is correct then move on to the KF214 and see if this value reaches the input of the KF214.
If we have 1kOhm at the input (before the connector) and we still face this error, you can try changing the small connector for one neighbour that
is not in use:
·
o
If this still doesn't work then we need to think about replacing KF214.
If the resistance you measure in XD212:7B or 8D is very different than 1kOhm then the cable can be faulty and needs to be replaced.
Let me know if you need assistance on site, I would recommend first to only bring a spare KF212, KF214 and Ethernet cable.
Have you tried rebooting the charger and see if it comes back?
For future reference, your ticket number is 0393915, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.

For the first error we should look for the ethernet connection and see if everything is alright, you can swap the ethernet cable with the DC3 and

If the CableTempSensor is not working, please check these connections:
You should measure resistance and it should be close to 1kOhm.
If this resistance is correct then move on to the KF214 and see if this value reaches the input of the KF214.

If the resistance you measure in XD212:7B or 8D is very different than 1kOhm then the cable can be faulty and needs to be replaced.
Let me know if you need assistance on site, I would recommend first to only bring a spare KF212, KF214 and Ethernet cable.
Have you tried rebooting the charger and see if it comes back?
For future reference, your ticket number is 0393915, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.

additional_info.subject: 0393915 - ID0393915-DC/Si-D/CH[170002200] - DC4 is not working CRM:00315002251
additional_info.body:
Hi all, good afternoon.
(I'm not sure why the ISP is crashing when I open the previous emails, perhaps due to too much images.)
From our site visit today we were able to bring back the DC4 to work. It seems that there were 2 misconfigurations from the comissioning or someone changed it deliberately.
This value here should be 613 and it was 612.
And
This EcoG had the configuration  in 10.17.20.103.
After changing the configurations back to what it should be, the DC4 is working again.
My feeling is that since the comissioning it never worked, or any of you changed the configuration for testing, from our side there was no one changing these configurations without requesting you first. So I believe that all the EcoGs and State Monitor are working from the previous replacements.
My personal opinion is, you can keep them for future replacements instead of waiting for a new one when the problem appears. If you wish to get your money back I can tell you to reach out to Karsten Gebauer, from what I understood, if the component is not used (depends on what they assume it's used) you can send it back. But since we already installed it once it might not accept it.
From my side, I left the charger with the newest components since it was working, even if the other components are working it would be a waste of time doing it all over again.
I will proceed to close the ticket since there is nothing else to do from my side.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
